outcome: maternal morbidities (postpartum hemorrhage, fistula, wound infection)
cohort: 513 cesarean deliveries at a high volume maternity hospital in Lilongwe, Malawi over three months.
finding: While adherence to oxytocin and antibiotic administration was high, uterine rupture and cesarean hysterectomy were associated with neonatal death, and infrastructure and personnel limitations were identified as major barriers to improving the quality of cesarean deliveries.
